author: AjH395
title: Fine But Tiring
content:
Ever played those slot machines that try to get you hooked on playing more and more of it? But then you realize you it’s costing your time and money to keep going so you consider maybe it’s time to call it? Yet as soon as you do, the machine slips you a morsel enough to get you to stay? Baiting you along so you slowing become addicted, while also peppering you with ads to buy your odds of getting that flashy cosmetic? That’s what this is. 

Really downloaded it because my significant other loves it as their pastime and I help them along to get those flashy cosmetics because it makes them happy.

Hasbro can have my money on Transformers rather than card packs that cost as much as Bumblebee. At least Bumblebee can be passed on as opposed the locked gold card I have a slim chance of pulling.

3/5 stars - one way to bond with your significant other, but has been lacking the earned reward feeling. Grinding can be frustrating, along with the dangling keys to entice you into more engagement to keep that dopamine going. Nothing else significant or stand out than your usual mobile game.

author: Rowltor
title: Money Grab!
content:
Don’t start playing unless you want to spend money to keep up. Last wild sticker of the season has taken the wild pack from 20k points needed to 31k, aka you need to buy dice. It sucks that games are now controlled on the developer end, this game was amazing when it came out. Wish I could buy the original game as  it was at the launch. It was a rare game of chance where the player had the advantage, they have quickly fixed it so the house wins!!!

UPDATE Aug 21,2025: The latest sticker pack is gold heavy, I don’t have any friends that are able to complete due to needing too many golds that are unable to be traded. I understand it’s about the money but it’s a shame because the game was just fun to play, now it’s a grind unless you are willing to spend money on dice. Latest quote from multiple friends in text, are you going to finish your album, “No and I am not even trying now with 5 days left and too many golds needed, this game is not even fun anymore.” It’s hard to get trades even for regulate stickers because the volume of players is no longer there. The latest racer game is setup so the people willing to use the most dice can win it. I’d give it 0 stars if I could. The bank heist has been changed and used to have more of the rings (top,prize) and it was nice to know you had a pretty good chance of hitting it, but it’s like casino now and all the odds are against you and with the house, which is a dice grab aka you have to pay to accomplish things that used to be attainable for everyone. I used to run 2 accounts because it was so fun, now having a second account feels like work so I don’t bother, try to keep playing on my main account for the nostalgia, but that is going away fast. I would say I don’t understand why they took all the odds away from the place and to the house but we all know why. It’s a cash grab game! It would be nice if it was brought back to the way it started!!!!!

UPDATE: After playing this game for over 2 years for the first time I have run out of dice and did not complete the sticker album (That used to give you 20k dice and like everything else dropped to 15k). It’s clear the number of players is down. You used to be able to trade stickers instantly with others but now it takes days sometimes to find a trade in the channels, just less people to trade with, with less stickers due to the nursing. This game was so fun in the beginning. I am finally dropping my account. If you like to spend money in game this is the game for you, if you like to play games for free I suggest you find another game! In the last partner event they took away spin rewards on the railroad game finish locations, it just keeps getting worse and worse. I guess there are enough people willing to pay up to play. Such a sad destruction of a game that was the best iOS game ever.

I have been playing the game for a couple years now and used to love it! However now they are nurfing the game I assume so more people will spend money to buy dice.

1. The top game used to give more of a multiplier and they have reduced it so it takes more dice to get the rewards. They also used to give out bigger awards each level you hit, these are reduced.
2. The side game same result.
3. They used to give a wild card on Quick Wins at least once or twice per sticker pack season. Now only 5*s.
4. The sticker album is harder to complete due to more gold stickers that cannot be traded per album. They do gold trade specials but not all golds in a season even come up for trading.
5. Getting extra stickers allows you to buy vaults for additional stickers. They now give 1 sticker in a green pack, they said to cut down on duplicates, aka to give you less stars to trade in. On top of that they used to offer a Wild pack in a vault and that is now gone.
6. The sticker album now gives 15k dice vs 20-25k dice in past albums that were easier to complete.
7. They have added a new sticker pack called a swap pack, a lot of times all you get is 3* stickers once you’re done with all your swapping. It’s a joke.
8. They have added new dice grab games. The racing game requires you to race other people and only 1st place after 3 races gets a wild sticker. You can spend tons of dice to try to get first with no control whatsoever of how much your competitors are willing to spend to win. The carnival game is random prizes with no visibility to what prizes are coming up or when you may get something of value. The haunted mansion game doesn’t even reward you with dice, just sticker packs, first side game to do that.
9. When they want you to burn more Peg-E’s they will use the star shaped game to do so vs the old style. Less points and a thinner path to the jackpot middle.

This game has a 4.8 star overall review but go look at them in recent order, most of the recent reviews are 1-3 star and a ton of 1 star. You getting the message yet Monopoly Go!!!!!

I saw a response from the team to a negative post that said people wanted the game to be more challenging. That is a very terrible spin on them basically admitting the above is all true. Just join a community and see that the sticker trading takes longer, because the game engagement is going down. Also explains why they are suddenly advertising the game more. I’m sure it is a matter of time, but it’s funny that they just want to squeeze out every last drop of revenue as quick as possible even if it means the game will eventually be destroyed.

The game is fun and it was more fun when it was a game you could play without spending money on dice, now it is only playable for the longer term if you are willing to pay for dice.

You can see by their response it is all true. The game is becoming a pay to play game. 

After being on since the beginning I’m deleting my account this month September 2026.

author: Ands2722
title: Awful customer service
content:
I am extremely disappointed with the customer service from MONOPOLY GO! I attempted to exchange stickers with another player in good faith, and that player took my stickers without holding up their end of the exchange.

I contacted customer support expecting actual assistance. Instead, I was initially told to “be more careful.” After pushing the issue, I was told they are investigating the other player, but they cannot discuss investigations with me. That’s fine—but what exactly does that do for me?

I’m the player who lost the stickers, yet nothing was offered to replace what I lost or make the situation right. An investigation that I’ll never hear the outcome of does absolutely nothing to restore my progress in the game. Meanwhile, the person who took my stickers got exactly what they wanted, and I’m left with the loss and advice to “be more careful.”

I understand there may be policies regarding investigations and what customer service can disclose. What I don’t understand is why MONOPOLY GO! apparently has no meaningful way to help the player who was actually affected. Players invest significant amounts of time and, in many cases, real money into this game. Customer support should be there to resolve problems, not simply acknowledge them, open an investigation, and leave the affected player empty-handed.

I wasn’t asking for confidential information about another player. I was asking MONOPOLY GO! to address what happened to MY account and the stickers I lost. Instead of feeling like a valued customer, I was made to feel like the problem was ultimately my responsibility for trusting another player.

That is not customer service, and it has completely changed the way I feel about supporting this game.
